data_description.evse_entities: Emporia switch entities for each EV charger
data_description.site_power_sensor: Reports total site power in kW — negative means exporting to the grid (excess solar)
data_description.battery_power_sensor: Reports battery power in kW — positive means the battery is discharging
data_description.voltage: Voltage of the EV charger circuits (typically 240V for residential)
data_description.debug_logging: Log detailed controller decisions to the Home Assistant log
data_description.disabled: Pause all controller activity without removing the integration
data_description.reset_state: Clear saved charge mode for all EVSEs and return to defaults on next restart
